messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync 1 Pinecrest agreed to a short case study tied to the benchmark. Need: quote sign-off, 25min recorded interview, legal OK for graphs, and lead form setup. Target: publish + webinar in 2.5 weeks.
Luis (Content): On it 1 I can draft a 2-paragraph blog + short tweet. Who's the PR contact?
Aaron (AE): PR = Ben Cho (ben@pinecrest.ai). I'll intro. For leads, please use HubSpot hidden form that tags pinecrest-bench and routes to AE pipeline.
Nina (Legal): Heads-up: must get a signed Customer Release for quotes and data. Prefer replacing raw QPS with 'production traffic' unless customer signs off on numbers.
Priya (CS): I'll export the benchmark charts and add a brief methodology note. One run showed GC spikes 1 will annotate.
scheduler-bot: Recording slot booked: "CaseSpotlight-Pinecrest" 1744140000 (3/31 9:00 PT). Link: https://meet.redwood/rooms/casespotlight-pinecrest
Luis (Content): Draft quote attempt: "Redwood reduced inference latency and let us accelerate launch timelines." Shorten?
Maya (Marketing): Good. Luis please draft 1-sentence and 2-line variants. Nina 1 can you pre-approve non-numeric phrasing?
Nina (Legal): Yes 1 non-numeric phrasing ok. If Pinecrest requests numbers, we need explicit written opt-in in the release.
Aaron (AE): I'll ask Ben if they'd like numbers public. If not, we'll use the vetted non-numeric copy. Sending the release form today.
Priya (CS): Sent charts to Luis with captions and CSVs. Visible note: 'test conditions: 8 GPU workers, 256-token prompt, occasional GC during run'.
Luis (Content): Got it 1 will weave methodology into an appendix slide for the webinar. Draft blog by tomorrow midday.
Maya (Marketing): Plan: Aaron gets signed release, Nina reviews, Priya finalizes assets, Luis drafts copy, scheduler-bot reserved room. Embargo until webinar date. Daily quick check-ins. :thumbsup:
